title: Creamy Irish Risotto
description: A rich and creamy Indian-inspired risotto dish made with Irish potatoes and Carnaroli rice.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add the Carnaroli rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of the chicken broth to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Repeat the process, adding the remaining 2 cups of broth in 1/2 cup increments, until the rice is cooked and creamy.
Stir in the heavy cream and garam masala.
Add the diced Irish potatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the risotto hot, garnished with a sprinkle of rice and a dollop of heavy cream, if desired.
